Debt maturities, interest expense and capex are not present in the snapshot, so balance-sheet risk remains a monitor rather than a resolved strength.
fundamentals.growth_outlook: The forward P/E discount and positive free cash flow support a moderate-growth or earnings-stabilization case, but no period-over-period revenue, EPS, subscriber or ARPU data is available. The evidence therefore supports a defensive income-oriented profile more strongly than a high-growth thesis; regulation, pricing and network investment could limit operating leverage.
